description: This file defines a Spring MVC Controller named SecurityController, handling user profile viewing and editing operations, including GET and POST endpoints for profile display, user data editing, and patch updating.

classes.name: SecurityController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing user profile viewing and editing functionalities, secured with role-based access control.

methods.name: getUserProfile
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the current user's profile and related courses.

methods.name: getForEdit
methods.description: Handles GET requests to show the user edit form for a specific user ID, with authentication check.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update user information if authenticated user matches the target user.

methods.name: patchUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to partially update user details if authenticated user matches the target user.
